mapper.sql: m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_type, m.menu_name, m.route_name, m.route_path, m.component_path, m.redirect, m.permission_code, m.sort_order, m.icon, m.active_icon, m.active_path, m.badge, m.badge_type, m.badge_variants, m.affix_tab, m.affix_tab_order, m.hide_in_menu, m.hide_children_in_menu, m.hide_in_breadcrumb, m.hide_in_tab, m.keep_alive, m.full_path_key, m.open_in_new_window, m.no_basic_layout, m.max_num_of_open_tab, m.query_params, m.link, m.iframe_src, m.created_at, m.created_by, m.updated_at, m.updated_by
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE authorized_menu AS ( SELECT DISTINCT assigned.id, assigned.parent_id FROM system_menu assigned INNER JOIN system_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = assigned.id INNER JOIN system_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND assigned.menu_type != 'CATALOG' UNION DISTINCT SELECT parent.id, parent.parent_id FROM system_menu parent INNER JOIN authorized_menu child ON parent.id = child.parent_id ) SELECT FROM system_menu m INNER JOIN authorized_menu authorized ON authorized.id = m.id WHERE m.menu_type != 'BUTTON' ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort_order, m.id
SELECT FROM system_menu m WHERE m.menu_type != 'BUTTON' ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort_order, m.id

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission_code FROM system_menu m INNER JOIN system_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN system_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.permission_code IS NOT NULL AND m.permission_code != '' ORDER BY m.permission_code
SELECT DISTINCT permission_code FROM system_menu WHERE permission_code IS NOT NULL AND permission_code != '' ORDER BY permission_code

WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS ( SELECT id, 0 AS depth FROM system_menu WHERE id = #{menuId} UNION ALL SELECT child.id, parent.depth + 1 FROM system_menu child INNER JOIN subtree parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id ) SELECT id FROM subtree ORDER BY depth DESC, id DESC
